pending_plan_data.action: Understand the default behavior of `git diff`
pending_plan_data.why: It shows differences between your working tree and the index (staged changes), helping you inspect local modifications.
`git diff` can compare working tree, index, commits, branches, or files depending on arguments.
Flags like `--stat`, `--name-only`, or `--cached` make the output easier to scan for specific review tasks.
